target_contract.allowed_changes: Notation and research method may evolve; changing the original problem requires a distinct target/spec version.
target_contract.completion: Complete original-scope proof or admissible counterexample with all load-bearing obligations discharged; evidence levels reported separately.

team.duty: Substantive mathematics, synthesis, actual Work dispatch, serial Git publication

team.input_policy: Original target, definitions and explicitly allowed obstacles only; no informed findings

launch.execution: Real platform spawn/followup only; JSON initialization does not launch a model.
launch.isolation: Input contract, not filesystem security; record actual reads and any profile conversion.

applications: Per-use spec pin, edge/object pins, direction, source-to-target mapping, condition proofs, actual conclusion, remaining, exact evidence and review scope.
persistence: Save substantive drafts and feedback promptly; Main serializes Git; only confirmed pushed is remote saved. Do not recreate retired boards.
restart: Recover published problem, notes, exact dependencies, unanswered feedback, next obligations and actual external job status; stale agent IDs do not imply live execution.
